items.title: 10-year Treasury yield drops back to 5% this week as investors seek cover from AI worries
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was just below 5% Friday after AI-driven tech selling sent investors into government bonds.
items.title_zh: 投资者因 AI 担忧寻求避险，10 年期美债收益率本周回落至 5%
items.summary_zh: 在 AI 驱动的科技股抛售推动投资者转向国债后，10 年期美债收益率周五略低于 5%。
